review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped for uses of the two final lemmas. sum_positive_iff_max_exponent is used in Patterns.lean (lines 98–99). sum_signed_powers_positive_iff has no use in the repository. The first four lemmas share only short calculations. The abs/neg reduction and the geometric-sum bound are each proved once. The one real repetition is the pivot-domination calc in the last two lemmas. I did not compile the proposed rewrite. The `id i` versus `i` unification in `hw` should go through by definitional unfolding, but I have not checked it.

  calc

findings.problem: This lemma and sum_positive_iff_max_exponent (lines 64–86) prove the same fact with the same skeleton. Both apply sum_positive_iff_pivot_positive, rewrite |w p| to a power of two, and replace |w i| by 2^(exponent i) over s.erase p with an identical sum_congr step. Both then bound the sum with sum_two_pow_lt. The ℕ version is the special case exponent = id of the general one. Injectivity is Function.injective_id. The hypothesis `i ≤ p` plus `i ≠ p` gives `i < p`. So the proof is maintained twice, and a change to the domination argument must be made in both places.
findings.proposed_change:
Place the general lemma first, then derive the ℕ lemma from it:

lemma sum_signed_powers_positive_iff (s : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ s) (hmax : ∀ i ∈ s, i ≤ p) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, |w i| = 2^i) :
    0 < ∑ i ∈ s, w i ↔ 0 < w p :=
  sum_positive_iff_max_exponent s w id Function.injective_id hp
    (fun i hi hne => lt_of_le_of_ne (hmax i hi) hne) hw

This removes the second copy of the calc. The ℕ lemma has no users in the repo, so it could also be deleted. Keeping it as this one-line corollary preserves the public API.
findings.benefit: One proof of the pivot-domination argument remains, which cuts about 12 lines. The ℕ statement is visibly an instance of the general lemma, so the two cannot drift apart.
